purpose: Second untouched external validation attempt of whether source-year quantitative seagrass state predicts next-year recorded-state instability.

relationship_to_tampa_discovery.frozen_hypothesis: Among annual sampling units with recorded seagrass presence, lower source-year quantitative cover adds out-of-time information about next-year recorded loss beyond a conventional space/time/effort baseline.
relationship_to_tampa_discovery.caribbean_v1: terminal protocol/schema STOP with zero model fits and zero predictive scores; Alaska v1 is a different response-unopened system and is not a repair.

source.title: Eelgrass (Zostera marina) Percent Cover Data from Katmai National Park and Preserve, Kenai Fjords National Park, and Prince William Sound, Alaska
source.stated_sampling: sonar and video drop cameras deployed from boats following prescribed survey transects
source.stated_data_layout: one comma-separated-values table with estimates of Zostera marina percent cover

gate0_metadata_only.allowed_network_request: one GET of ScienceBase item metadata JSON
gate0_metadata_only.csv_selection_rule: exactly one ScienceBase file whose name ends case-insensitively with .csv
forbidden: changing candidate system based on response values

hypothesis_boundary.primary_endpoint: next-year recorded loss from a source-year unit with recorded Zostera presence
hypothesis_boundary.quantitative_predictor: source-year Zostera percent-cover state, using the published quantitative cover field under a parser frozen after schema-only inspection
hypothesis_boundary.baseline: space/time/effort only; no response-derived ecological state
hypothesis_boundary.split: strict walk-forward by target calendar year

decision_rule.favorable: augmented macro log loss < baseline AND augmented wins >= ceil(0.60 * scored target years)
decision_rule.adverse: baseline macro log loss < augmented AND baseline wins >= ceil(0.60 * scored target years)

no_rescue_rules: Do not open CSV payload before Gate0 metadata-only result is frozen.
Do not switch focal species, data release, or years after response access.
Do not lower estimability minima after response access.
Do not redefine recorded loss after response access.
Do not select another quantitative eelgrass variable to rescue an unfavorable result.
Schema or linkage failure after response access terminates Alaska v1; any repair is a new protocol and not the same untouched confirmation.
